card.line: Ezion-geber was an ancient harbor city on the Red Sea, near Elath, where Israel camped in the wilderness and where kings of Israel and Judah built ships.

moments.title: Israel camps at Ezion-geber
moments.text: On their journey through the wilderness, the Israelites set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber. Then they moved on to Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.

moments.title: Solomon goes to Ezion-geber
moments.text: After the house of the LORD was finished, Solomon went to Ezion-geber and Eloth on the coast of Edom. Hiram sent ships and skilled sailors, who went with Solomon's servants to Ophir and brought back 450 talents of gold.

moments.title: Jehoshaphat's ships are wrecked
moments.text: Jehoshaphat joined with Ahaziah to build ships at Ezion-geber to sail to Tarshish. Eliezer prophesied against him, and the ships were wrecked and never sailed.
